title: 🌿 Post-Surgery Recovery with Ayurveda in India
h1: Heal Faster, Naturally – Complement Your Surgery with Ayurveda
intro: Modern surgery saves lives — but recovery can be slow and painful. Ayurveda offers safe, natural therapies that speed up healing, reduce side effects, and restore strength after major surgeries. Our partner Ayurvedic doctors in India create personalized recovery programs combining herbal medicines, massages, detox therapies, and diet plans.

sections.heading: Benefits of Ayurveda for Post-Surgery Recovery
points: Supports mental health, reducing stress & anxiety

sections.heading: Ayurvedic Therapies for Recovery

Shirodhara (Oil Drip Therapy): Calms the nervous system, helps with stress & insomnia
Basti (Medicated Enema): Strengthens immunity and supports gut health
Rasayana (Rejuvenation Therapy): Herbal tonics to rebuild tissues and enhance vitality
Special Ayurvedic Diet: Customized meal plans to restore strength naturally

sections.heading: Why International Patients Choose Ayurveda After Surgery

Personalized care from certified Ayurveda doctors
Affordable recovery programs in India’s best wellness centers
Ideal for patients after heart surgery, orthopedic surgery, cancer treatment, and transplant recovery
